title: Michigan City Municipal Band
description: Free outdoor concert series every Thursday in summer. Bring a blanket, grab food from nearby vendors, enjoy live music on the lake.

title: Michigan City Farmers Market
description: Producers-only market: fresh produce, artisan breads, local honey, live music. 100-mile radius requirement keeps it authentic.

title: Blue Chip Casino: Live at Stardust
address: 777 Blue Chip Dr, Michigan City, IN
description: National touring act at the Stardust Event Center. Dinner + show packages available through the casino.

title: Singing Sands Sand Sculpting Festival
description: World-class sand sculptors, competitions, and a community challenge. One of the coolest events on the lake.

title: First Friday Art Walk
description: Monthly gallery openings, live music, shuttle service. The heartbeat of downtown Michigan City's creative scene.

title: Burn 'Em Brewing: Saturday Live Music
description: Live band on the patio. 20+ beers on tap. No cover.

title: Lighthouse Place Spring Sidewalk Sale
description: Extra markdowns at 70+ stores. Nike, Coach, North Face, Kate Spade — all with additional sale-on-sale pricing.

title: Charter Season Opens — King Salmon Running
address: Washington Park Marina, Michigan City, IN
description: Coho and King Salmon are in. Book a charter now before the calendar fills. Fire Drill, Tightline, Colorblind all taking trips.

title: Zorn Brew Works: Taco Tuesday
description: The local institution. $3 tacos, craft beers, laid-back Tuesday energy. Families welcome.

title: Great Lakes Grand Prix Powerboat Race
description: World-class offshore powerboat racing. Free shoreline viewing. One of the biggest events of the summer. Huge crowds, food vendors, live music.

title: Sunset Sail — MC Sailboat Charters
address: 709 E Barker Ave, Michigan City, IN
description: 2-hour captained sunset cruise on a 34-ft sailboat. BYOB. Book for 2-6 people.

title: Taste of Michigan City
description: Dozens of local restaurants, beer garden, live music all day. The biggest food event of the summer.

title: Blues Festival
description: Two-day blues festival on the lakefront. National and regional acts. Food vendors, beer tent.
